html:
If you are staying in Hanoi and looking for a private car transfer to Ninh Binh or a day trip to Ninh Binh from Hanoi, consider booking Hanoi to Ninh Binh Private Car now with an experienced driver through Vietlook Travel.

The distance from Hanoi to Ninh Binh is approximately 95 km, and it takes around 2 hours to transfer by car one way. Unlike other forms of transportation from Hanoi to Ninh Binh, such as buses, shared limousines, or taxis, they are not flexible or convenient. This is a door-to-door private transfer service, allowing you to choose your departure time and customize the itinerary.

HANOI TO NINH BINH BY PRIVATE CAR

To ensure you have a great experience in Ninh Binh, Vietlook Travel offers a range of travel options to cater to all your diverse needs.

Option 1: Hanoi Airport to Ninh Binh Transfer

Please provide us with your flight number/landing time, the number of people, and your hotel name/address in Ninh Binh. Our travel expert will send you a sedan car, SUV, or minivan to pick you up. He will be waiting at the Hanoi airport arrival gate with your full name displayed on a welcome board, so you can easily recognize him.

After exchanging greetings, our driver will introduce you to the car and assist you with loading your luggage. A direct transfer from Hanoi Airport to the Ninh Binh Hotel takes approximately 2 hours. If you have ample time, you can ask our travel experts to customize your itinerary. Depending on your schedule, you can visit Mua Cave, Hoa Lu, Tam Coc, Bai Dinh Pagoda, or the Trang An scenic landscape complex.

Upon arrival at your hotel in Ninh Binh, our friendly driver will assist you with your luggage and inspect the car to ensure that you don’t leave anything behind. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great stay in Ninh Binh city.

Option 2: Hanoi to Ninh Binh Day Trip

With this option, we highly recommend you start the trip early. At 8:00 am, our driver and Hanoi private car will pick you up at your hotel lobby, and we will start the Hanoi to Ninh Binh day trip. Along the way, you can ask our driver to stop at convenient places to use the toilets, have lunch, and enjoy a cup of coffee.

You can choose one of the travel routes below because of the time limit of the day.

  • Route 1: Hanoi Hotel to Hoa Lu Ancient Capital – Tam Coc – Mua Cave – Hanoi Hotel.
  • Route 2: Hanoi to Bai Dinh Pagoda, Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex, Mua Cave, and Hanoi Hotel.

After all, we will transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi and finish the private car Hanoi to Ninh Binh day trip. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great day with us.

Travel Thoughts:

  • The Hoa Lu ancient capital relic area costs 20,000 VND per person.
  • The entrance ticket price to Mua Cave is 100,000 VND per person.
  • The Tam Coc-Bich Dong entrance ticket costs 200,000 VND/turn/boat (for two foreign visitors) and is free of charge for children under 3 years old. Children under 1.4 meters: 100,000 VND/pax/turn.
  • Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex entrance ticket costs
  • Trang An ecological Trang An new caves: 250,000 VND/adult, children below 1,4 meters: 100,000 VND/pax. Ancient Trang An area: 45,000 VND per person.
  • Bai Dinh Pagoda: Electric golf car service: 30,000 VND per person per turn; 50,000 VND/ pax for visiting Bao Tower.

Why Should You Choose Us?

  • Door-to-door private transfer service with an experienced driver.
  • A baby seat is available upon request and is provided free of charge for one.
  • We offer a competitive and best price without hidden costs.
  • Comfortable cars with seat belts and strong A/C.
  • A private car from Ninh Binh to Hanoi is always available and costs the same price.
  • Our travel experts are always available and willing to support you via Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588, (Zalo/WhatsApp/Wechat) / (+84) 98.339.3488.
